mission.title: nats: Leafnode with server_name never receives interest, and drops requests/replies, across account imports on its own links
mission.description: Leafnode with server_name never receives interest, and drops requests/replies, across account imports on its own links. Requested by 12+ users.

steps.title: Check current nats deployment
steps.description:
Verify your nats version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n nats -l app.kubernetes.io/name=nats
helm list -n nats 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working nats installation.

steps.title: Review nats configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant nats configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n nats -l app.kubernetes.io/name=nats
kubectl get configmap -n nats -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=nats
```
### Observed behavior

A leafnode server that solicits remotes, has no cluster block, and has a server_name takes its cluster name from server_name.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Leafnode with server_name never receives interest, and…
Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n nats -l app.kubernetes.io/name=nats
kubectl get events -n nats --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Leafnode with server_name never receives interest, and…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: A leaf with solicited remotes and no cluster block takes its cluster name from server_name. The hub tags subscriptions from its links with that cluster as the origin, and the origin was wrongly applied to interest and messages that crossed an account import.

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with nats installed or the issue environment reproducible.
